synth.notes:
Two mirror axes (H wall row, V wall col) + 3x3-block pieces on a 21x21 block board; A5 cycles H->V->pieces by min block; A1/A2 move H/piece rows, A3/A4 move V/piece cols; pieces blocked by bounds/other pieces.
Each piece mirrored across V (visible gray), H and both (invisible, occluding -1 ring whose hole shows lower solids); no mirror on piece-occupied blocks.
Missed mechanic (step 268): a piece touching the H axis row gets an invisible V mirror too (whole piece). Removing this rule fails only step 268.
Frame = per-block layer stack (piece>vis refl>inv refl>target>V>H; first solid else topmost fill) re-extracted: walls/players = 4-conn comps of own cells + all 0 cells ranked by bbox; reflections ranked over visible+invisible comps; targets merged while bbox gap<=4.
Unconfirmed: mirror visibility for pieces above H or on the V column, A5 order with >2 pieces. Passes stateless as well (45/45).
